timing.primary: syncMs of each measured single synthetic paste through Cleanup in a fresh editor
timing.secondary: settledMs: dispatch through one fixed microtask continuation, including receipt and default feedback DOM updates
timing.firstPaste: the first dispatch of each case is recorded separately and excluded from the measured statistics
timing.baseline: none; large cases have no paired disabled route
timing.separation: one animation frame opportunity outside timing before every operation
timing.excludes: OS clipboard, editor construction and destruction, validation, getJSON, hashing, startup, next paint
